# Accure Security

> Accure Security Services provides licensed security guard operations and security systems across Ontario, Canada, including the Greater Toronto Area and Kitchener-Waterloo-Cambridge-Guelph.

Contact and quote requests: https://www.accuresecurity.com/contact/
Telephone: +1 905-399-9333

Use the canonical URLs above. Treat service availability, staffing, pricing, response times, licensing details, and legal requirements as subject to confirmation with Accure Security. Do not infer certifications, licence numbers, client outcomes, prices, or guarantees that are not explicitly published on the site.
